findings.highlight: sweat dripping down my neck
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たい汗が流れている
findings.governingReading: cold sweat runs down his neck
findings.explanation: The physical sign of dread loses its temperature.

findings.highlight: his MasterKotomine
findings.evidenceJa: マスター言峰を討つ
findings.governingReading: strike down his Master, Kotomine
findings.explanation: The title and name are fused into malformed English.

findings.highlight: I cannot allow him to beat me
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=か]彼の王に膝を屈する事はできません
findings.governingReading: She cannot bend the knee to that king.
findings.explanation: Saber’s refusal of royal submission becomes a generic refusal to lose.

findings.highlight: even if Saber diesif I defeat Kotomine
findings.evidenceJa: もしセイバーが倒れたとしても俺が言峰を倒せば
findings.governingReading: even if Saber falls, if Shirou defeats Kotomine
findings.explanation: The conditional clauses are fused.

findings.highlight: The long and short days of battle
findings.evidenceJa: 長く、一瞬だった戦いの日々
findings.governingReading: days of battle that were long, yet passed in an instant
findings.explanation: A temporal paradox becomes a plain size contrast.

findings.highlight: talked with Fuji-nee
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえとテンポの合わない会話をしてた
findings.governingReading: held conversations with Fuji-nee whose rhythm never matched hers
findings.explanation: The comic mismatch between Saber and Taiga disappears.

findings.highlight: I realized that I loved Saber
findings.evidenceJa: どうしようもなく好きなんだと気が付いた
findings.governingReading: he realized he loved her beyond all help
findings.explanation: The helpless, overwhelming degree of Shirou’s love disappears.

findings.highlight: there’ll be nothing for us to talk about
findings.evidenceJa: お互い言葉を交わす事はない
findings.governingReading: they will exchange no more words
findings.explanation: Inability to speak after the threshold becomes absence of conversational topics.

findings.highlight: If I talk, that’ll be our final conversation
findings.evidenceJa: 何か言葉にすれば、それが別れの言葉になる
findings.governingReading: Any words he speaks will become words of farewell.
findings.explanation: The transformation of each utterance into goodbye becomes a generic last conversation.

findings.highlight: A tense stare with a composed expression
findings.evidenceJa: 何かを堪えているような、張りつめた瞳
findings.governingReading: taut eyes that seem to be enduring something beneath her composed face
findings.explanation: The pain Saber appears to suppress disappears.

findings.highlight: She would accompany me if I wished
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女なら、おまえがそうしたいと言えば受け入れてくれる
findings.governingReading: She would accept it if he said that was what he wanted.
findings.explanation: Saber’s acceptance of Shirou’s choice is narrowed to physical accompaniment.

findings.highlight: The long stairs
findings.evidenceJa: 長い長い石の階段
findings.governingReading: the long, long stone stairway
findings.explanation: Repetition and material setting disappear.

findings.highlight: our final memory of our time together
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ここ o2o=1]地上で最後の思い出
findings.governingReading: their last memory on earth, read as “here”
findings.explanation: The written cosmic location and intimate deictic reading disappear.

findings.highlight: does not kill anything it swallows
findings.evidenceJa: 呑み込まれたモノを殺さずにはおかない泥
findings.governingReading: mud that cannot fail to kill whatever it swallows
findings.explanation: The lethal property is reversed into nonlethality.

findings.highlight: It’s like a visible curse
findings.evidenceJa: 視覚できる程の呪いに他ならない
findings.governingReading: It is nothing other than a curse dense enough to see.
findings.explanation: An identification is weakened into simile.

findings.highlight: only reacts to the human mind
findings.evidenceJa: 人の精神にのみ作用し
findings.governingReading: acts only upon the human mind
findings.explanation: Causal magical action becomes passive reaction.

findings.highlight: hundreds of Noble Phantasms
findings.evidenceJa: 百を超える“宝具”
findings.governingReading: more than one hundred Noble Phantasms
findings.explanation: The stated lower-bound quantity is inflated into multiple hundreds.

findings.highlight: unable to stop yourself from going crazy, disgracing yourself, and begging at my feet
findings.evidenceJa: 泣き噎ぶ顔を踏み付けその体を染め抜くほどの泥を飲ませ、悶え死ぬに耐えきれず[ruby text=オレ]我の足下にすがりつく
findings.governingReading: He threatens to tread on her sobbing face, force down enough mud to stain her body through, and make her cling to his feet when she cannot bear dying in agony.
findings.explanation: The concrete coercion, degradation, mud, and death agony are replaced by generic madness and disgrace.

findings.highlight: wishing me her best
findings.evidenceJa: 無事を祈る
findings.governingReading: praying for his safety
findings.explanation: A specific prayer that Shirou survive becomes a vague encouragement.

findings.highlight: that’s all in the past
findings.evidenceJa: それは昨日までの話
findings.governingReading: that was true until yesterday
findings.explanation: A precise recent boundary becomes indefinite past.

findings.highlight: My calm mind instantly goes over the limit
findings.evidenceJa: 冷静を演じてきた思考が、一瞬にして[ruby text=レート o2o=1]通常値を振り切る
findings.governingReading: His thought, which had been performing calm, instantly exceeds its normal rate.
findings.explanation: The feigned calm and written/ruby rate relation disappear.

findings.highlight: stab his chest
findings.evidenceJa: その胸を断つしかない
findings.governingReading: he has no choice but to sever that chest
findings.explanation: A cutting objective is changed to stabbing.

findings.highlight: excess things such as their lives
findings.evidenceJa: 営みなどという贅肉
findings.governingReading: the excess flesh of human activity and living
findings.explanation: Human pursuits are mistranslated as lives themselves.

findings.highlight: I live by feeding on this planet’s light
findings.evidenceJa: 星の光を食べて生きている
findings.governingReading: this body lives by feeding on starlight
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s metaphor of consuming stellar flashes is changed to planetary light.

findings.highlight: Damnyou fake priest
findings.evidenceJa: このエセ神父
findings.governingReading: You sham priest…!
findings.explanation: The insult is fused into malformed English.

findings.highlight: I hated you for that
findings.evidenceJa: おまえには、アレで愛想がつきていた
findings.governingReading: That incident had exhausted his patience/interest in Shirou.
findings.explanation: A withdrawal of interest is intensified into hatred.

findings.highlight: get my revenge on Emiya Kiritsugu
findings.evidenceJa: もう一度引導を渡せる
findings.governingReading: administer the final rite / decisive end to Kiritsugu once more
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s clerical death idiom becomes a direct revenge motive.

findings.highlight: unless you have something major
findings.evidenceJa: 何かで掛け算でもしないかぎり、埋められる[ruby text=さ char=2]数値ではあるまい
findings.governingReading: not a numerical gap he can close unless he multiplies his years by something
findings.explanation: The mathematical taunt, ruby, and experience gap mechanism disappear.

findings.highlight: If the yell is a rip
findings.evidenceJa: 気合いが[ruby text=れっぱく char=2]裂帛ならば
findings.governingReading: Her fighting cry has the force to split silk.
findings.explanation: An idiom and its ruby are rendered as nonsense.

findings.highlight: He is serious
findings.evidenceJa: 彼は存外本気で言っているのだろう
findings.governingReading: Unexpectedly, he may be speaking in earnest.
findings.explanation: A viewpoint-bound inference is promoted to fact.

findings.highlight: She cannot be defeated here by him
findings.evidenceJa: この男に膝を屈する事はできない
findings.governingReading: She cannot bend the knee to this man here.
findings.explanation: Saber’s refusal of submission is again reduced to defeat.

findings.highlight: produced in the air
findings.evidenceJa: 空間に“展開”され
findings.governingReading: deployed in space
findings.explanation: A tactical deployment is changed into creation.

findings.highlight: an archer with the strongest arrows
findings.evidenceJa: 最強の魔弾の射手
findings.governingReading: the marksman of the strongest magical bullets
findings.explanation: The explanation of his Archer class is changed from projectile weapons to ordinary arrows.

findings.highlight: She eludes every one of them
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ことごと]悉くを受け流す
findings.governingReading: She parries and diverts every last one.
findings.explanation: Active weapon deflection becomes evasion.

findings.highlight: She jumps full force
findings.evidenceJa: 推進剤でも使ったかのような跳躍
findings.governingReading: a leap as though propelled by rocket fuel
findings.explanation: The explosive propulsion simile disappears.

findings.highlight: EX
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=エクス char=5]約束された
findings.governingReading: Ex— / the promised—
findings.explanation: The interrupted incantation’s written meaning disappears.

findings.highlight: Enuma Elish
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=エヌマ char=5]天地乖離す、[ruby text=エリシュ char=4]開闢の星
findings.governingReading: Heaven and earth split, star of creation—read “Enuma Elish.”
findings.explanation: Only the ruby name remains; the written incantation vanishes.

findings.highlight: I can’t even tell if it’s there
findings.evidenceJa: カカトから先がくっついているかさえ判らなかった
findings.governingReading: He cannot tell whether everything from the heel onward is still attached.
findings.explanation: The precise feared extent of bodily loss disappears.

findings.highlight: forces my dizzy head awake
findings.evidenceJa: 目眩を起こす頭をしぼって、立ち上がって
findings.governingReading: He strains his reeling head and stands.
findings.explanation: Deliberate cognitive effort and standing are replaced by involuntary awakening.

findings.highlight: That must have been the end of this attack
findings.evidenceJa: それで追撃は止んだのか
findings.governingReading: Had that stopped the follow-up attack?
findings.explanation: A question is promoted to a confident conclusion.

findings.highlight: It’s about to go out on its own
findings.evidenceJa: 喉から這い上がってきそうな勢い
findings.governingReading: as though his heart might crawl up and out through his throat
findings.explanation: The grotesque bodily route and crawling image disappear.

findings.highlight: I’m not going to hold back on using the ‘projection’ magic
findings.evidenceJa: 出し惜しみなんてしていない
findings.governingReading: He is not withholding Projection now.
findings.explanation: Present inability despite willingness becomes future intent.

findings.highlight: I raise myself
findings.evidenceJa: アゴをあげて
findings.governingReading: He jerks/raises his chin.
findings.explanation: A precise evasive movement becomes whole-body elevation.

findings.highlight: Waiting behind Kotomine is a pool of mud
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツの背後にはそれこそ泥が滝になっている
findings.governingReading: Behind Kotomine the mud forms an actual waterfall.
findings.explanation: A vertical mass blocking approach becomes a pool.

findings.highlight: requires at least one minute of concentration
findings.evidenceJa: 最短でも一分近い精神集中
findings.governingReading: requires nearly a minute of concentration even at minimum
findings.explanation: The estimate is lengthened and its approximation reversed.

findings.highlight: a pool of mud
findings.evidenceJa: 泥が滝になっている
findings.governingReading: mud forming a waterfall
findings.explanation: The spatial obstacle is again changed from waterfall to pool.

findings.highlight: many snakes show their veins
findings.evidenceJa: 蛇が鎌首をもたげた
findings.governingReading: The snakes raise their hooded heads.
findings.explanation: A threatening snake posture becomes nonsensical exposed veins.

findings.highlight: My right ankle is unbelievably black
findings.evidenceJa: 右足が、信じられないぐらい真っ黒
findings.governingReading: His right leg/foot is unbelievably black.
findings.explanation: The affected bodily extent is narrowed to the ankle.

findings.highlight: move the clotted blood in there
findings.evidenceJa: 凝固した血液をぶちまける
findings.governingReading: violently expel the coagulated blood
findings.explanation: A proposed purging action becomes internal movement.

findings.highlight: stuck his hand in that waterfall of mud
findings.evidenceJa: 毒の源たるあの滝に手を触れて
findings.governingReading: touches his hand to that waterfall, the source of the poison
findings.explanation: Contact with the source is intensified into inserting his hand.

findings.highlight: Die in the same manner as Kiritsugu
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣と同じ末路を辿れ
findings.governingReading: Meet the same ultimate fate as Kiritsugu.
findings.explanation: A shared ruin or end is narrowed to identical manner of death.

findings.highlight: Angra Mainyu
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=アンリマユ char=8]この世、全ての悪
findings.governingReading: All the world’s evil—read “Angra Mainyu.”
findings.explanation: The defining written meaning is entirely omitted.
